Emmet's Place

Modern Masters: Chris Potter, John Patitucci & Johnathan Blake - Live From Emmet's Place Vol. 142 (2026)

June 22, 2026 · Power Station at Berklee NYC

Watch on YouTube

Setlist

  1. Relaxin’ at the Camarillo (comp. Charlie Parker, 1947)
  2. Airegin (comp. Sonny Rollins, 1954 / ‘Miles with Sonny’ & rec. by the Miles Davis Quintet)
  3. Emmet Cohen Greets the Audience & Champions of this Music, who join him on the Power Studio Stage: Johnathan Blake, drums; John Patitucci, bass, and Chris Potter, tenor saxophone
  4. I’m An Old Cowhand (From The Río Grande) (comp. Johnny Mercer, 1936 / Sonny Rollins’ “Way Out West,” 1957)
  5. The Visitor (comp. Chris Potter)
  6. Emmet Acknowledges His first opportunity to play with this ensemble of cats // The rewards & spontaneity of the Livestream // Gratitude for the Partnerships with Power Station at BerkleeNYC & Open Studio, & the bass drum art of Alex Alpert
  7. Everything Happens To Me (comp. Matt Dennis; lyr. Tom Adair / Sonny Rollins on Impulse!, 1965)
  8. Bassist John Patitucci reflects on creativity as a member of the Chick Corea Quartet
  9. That Old Feeling (comp. Sammy Fain; lyr. Lew Brown)
  10. Fe Fi Fo Fum (comp. Wayne Shorter / Speak No Evil, 1966 )
  11. Emmet Recalls his mentorship under the celebrated violinist, John Edward Blake, Jr. — & late, beloved father of drummer Johnathan Blake
  12. Rivers & Parks (comp. Johnathan Blake, 2021)
  13. Body & Soul (comp. Johnny Green; lyr. E. Heyman, R. Sour, F. Eaton,1930)
  14. Deepest Appreciation for the Generosity & Sponsorship Enabling This Evening’s Performance
  15. Emmet Cohen features latest album, Universal Truth & spotlights newest project by tenor saxophonist, Chris Potter
  16. Invitation (comp. Bronislaw Kaper; lyr. Paul Francis Webster, 1950)
  17. Emmet’s Place Theme & Closing Scenes
